name: group-cardinality-pressure
description: Capture group-count pressure with region, category and user dimensions

queries.name: region-groups
queries.sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

queries.name: category-groups
queries.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

queries.name: user-groups
queries.sql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY user_id

queries.name: user-topk
queries.sql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY 2 DESC, user_id ASC LIMIT 25
